headline: Fines for those who employ undocumented workers total RD$20.3 MM
summary: Migration authorities imposed fines totalling 20,325,000 pesos on companies employing foreign workers without legal status, across 113 sanctions. The average fine was 179,867 pesos.
why: Labor compliance and immigration enforcement affect hiring costs and operating risk for employers. Investors in sectors reliant on foreign labor watch such enforcement closely.
original_headline: Multas a quienes emplean indocumentados suman RD$20.3 MM
